name: Redfin Data Center
tagline: Market metrics and downloadable housing data from Redfin; limited programmatic access.
description: Redfin Data Center publishes housing market metrics and downloadable datasets (city, ZIP, neighborhood, and metro-level). It is primarily a data download portal rather than a full self-serve developer API; programmatic access is limited and not a documented public REST product for general app use.

auth.details: No public self-serve developer API key; Data Center offers free CSV/Excel downloads. Unofficial/internal endpoints may not require auth but are unsupported and subject to blocking.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public downloads of market data files; no documented request quotas for a developer API

example.request: curl -sL 'https://www.redfin.com/news/data-center/downloads/' | grep -o 'Redfin Data Center Download Hub' | head -1

use_cases: download monthly housing market metrics by city or metro
track median sale prices and inventory trends over time
compare housing demand metrics across ZIP codes
pull Redfin housing market CSVs for offline analysis
